title: The Hermits
logline: Two tales of mountain hermits: an old man who shares his daily bread with a pair of pigeons until the mountain is full of birds, and a sick shepherd who passes an angel's test and is then found, through a dream, by the friend he will grow old with.
moral: Quiet goodness is never alone: kindness to small creatures and steadiness under temptation bring company, peace and a good end.
tone: Gentle, warm and still, with small animal comedy (the turban dove, the shorn sheep, the wolf who lies down with the lamb). The two deaths are peaceful and told by stillness, never by a fall.

beats.summary: An old hermit alone on a far mountain.
He splits his daily bread: half for himself, half for a pair of pigeons.
His blessing works: the mountain fills with birds (one lands on his turban).
The birds gather round him and praise God.
The hermit dies quietly; the flocks scatter.
Another mountain, another good man: the shepherd.
A wolf stalks the flock during prayer, and lies down among the sheep.
The shepherd falls gravely ill and keeps to his cave.
A beautiful woman enters and offers to stay and nurse him.
Her shadow shows wings: she is an angel testing him (the audience knows, he does not).
He refuses: he has chosen worship.
After three more tries he covers his face with his robe and prays.
Test passed: the angel rises to heaven as light; a feather remains.
In a nearby village a devout man dreams he must visit the shepherd.
At the spring the animals flee from him; he grieves and gives the place back to them.
He reaches the cave; the shepherd welcomes him with astonishment and joy.
The two live together: prayer, the flock, milk and a shared pot.
They grow old and die on the mountain; the doves return. The end.

sets.description: The top terrace of the planned 'rockyHill' (cave off, pinnacle off), world 1000 x 2000. Terrace ground y 900 from x 0 to 780; cliff edge at x 780 dropping to y 2000 in three grey shelves (y 1150, 1450, 1750) with dot shading. Flat sitting rock 150 x 48 at x 330 (top y 852). Crumb slab 90 x 20 at x 540 (top y 880). Dead snag at x 640: trunk 26 wide up to y 520, left branch tip (560, 600), right branch tip (730, 560), nest fork (640, 640). Far peaks (planned 'mountain' far version at 40 %) on the horizon; tiny village (six 30 px houses) at about (880, 1700). Sky from skyCycle (noon, then dusk in S3).

A 1600-wide hillside composed from Library pieces: skyCycle, hillTrees, treeRow (hmin 360, left half only), ground at y 900, and den() translated +600 so the cave mouth is on the right (about x 1150-1560, arch top about y 560, rock top about y 500: approximate, measure on the set). If den() draws the lion's bones, cover them with a ground strip or add an opt-in {bones:false} (default unchanged). Bush (w 260) at x 140 for the wolf; tree() at x 520 with crown colours that can be tinted for the seasons; two flat stones 110 x 48 at x 1010 and 1090 (S15-S16); a mat inside the mouth at x 1250-1480 (S6).

The planned 'burrowChamber' in a rock palette. World 1000 x 1230, floor y 900. Grey rock with blue dot shading fills the frame; rounded cavity x 110-930, y 500-930, navy interior with blue dots. Mouth opening in the right wall x 800-930, y 600-900 showing the sky (skyCycle). Mat 280 x 16 on the floor at x 180-460 (shepherd's hips at x 330, head toward the left at about x 210). Wall niche with the planned oilLamp at (150, 640). The back wall between x 520 and 760, y 520-860 is kept flat and bare: it is the screen for the angel shadow.
The planned 'hutRoom' cutaway at night: floor y 900, floor mattress at x 250-650, window with moon at (760, 520), oilLamp on a shelf at (180, 600).

An 1800-wide road strip from Library pieces: sky day with a large sun, hillTrees, ground y 900. Far village silhouette (five roofs, 160 wide) on the horizon at x 150. Shade tree: tree() at x 1150, trunk 100 wide, crown top y 300, with a dot-shade patch on the ground x 1020-1300. Spring: a pool ellipse 260 x 46 centred (1420, 905), blue with white glints, rim of five grey stones, three reeds at its right end (the planned 'pond' drawing at small size). Two bushes (w 270) at x 1650 and 1760, drawn after the hiding animals.

props.description: Round flat loaf r 34, brown crust with dot shading and three score marks. split 0..1 separates two halves (cream cut faces); bite adds a notch; crumbs are 4 px dots.
Prayer beads (planned 'beads'): a loop of 14 brown beads r 4 with one tassel, hanging from a hand point with swing(); can drop and lie on the ground.
Library nest with eggs 3 then chicks 3, in the snag fork.
The planned 'smallBowl' with fill 0..1 (white milk) and steam.
Covered cooking pot 90 x 70, dark with a yellow highlight, lid with a knob (lidOff 0..1), steam curl; sits on three flame shapes (red, yellow, white).
A single white feather 34 long from the planned 'featherFall' effect; the linking motif between the two tales.

subtitles.ar: عاش ناسك على جبل بعيد،|وكان يقتسم خبزه كل يوم: نصفًا يأكله،|ونصفًا يقدمه لزوج من الحمام.|دعا لهما بالخير، فكثر نسلهما وامتلأ الجبل بالطيور.
subtitles.en: A hermit lived on a distant mountain.|Each day he ate half his bread|and gave the other half to a pair of pigeons.|Their young multiplied.

subtitles.ar: كانت الطيور تجتمع قرب الرجل|وتسبح الله كما تروي الحكاية.|لكن الناسك مات يومًا، فتفرقت أسراب الحمام في القرى والجبال.|وفي جبل آخر بدأت حكاية رجل صالح جديد.
subtitles.en: The birds gathered near him|and praised God, as the tale relates.|When the hermit died, they scattered through villages and mountains.|Another story began on another mountain.

subtitles.ar: كان هناك راع يرعى غنمه ويعيش من لبنها وصوفها.|اعتاد الصلاة في هدوء، ولم تهاجم الوحوش قطيعه.|ثم أصابه مرض شديد،|فلزم كهفًا، بينما تخرج غنمه للرعي وتعود مساءً.
subtitles.en: A shepherd lived from his sheep’s milk and wool,|praying in peace while wild beasts left the flock alone.|Then he fell gravely ill|and stayed in a cave.

subtitles.ar: ذات يوم دخلت عليه امرأة جميلة،|وقالت: أستطيع أن أؤنس وحدتك وأساعدك على الشفاء؛ دعني أبقى معك.|كانت في الحقيقة مَلَكًا جاء في صورة امرأة|ليمتحن ثباته.
subtitles.en: One day a beautiful woman entered|and offered to keep him company and help him recover.|She was really an angel in a woman’s form,|testing his resolve.

subtitles.ar: رفض الراعي عرضها وقال: اخترت العبادة، ولا أريد أن أترك طريقي.|حاولت إقناعه أكثر من مرة،|لكنه غطى وجهه بثوبه ودعا الله.|عندئذ انتهى الامتحان، وصعد المَلَك إلى السماء.
subtitles.en: The shepherd refused, saying he had chosen devotion.|She tried again,|but he covered his face and prayed.|The test ended, and the angel ascended to heaven.

subtitles.ar: وفي قرية قريبة رأى رجل متعبد حلمًا يأمره بزيارة الراعي.|خرج يبحث عنه في حر النهار،|ثم جلس ليستريح عند عين ماء تحت شجرة،|فرأى حيوانات وطيورًا تقترب للشرب.
subtitles.en: In a nearby village another devotee dreamed he should visit the shepherd.|Traveling in the heat,|he rested by a spring|and saw birds and animals coming to drink.

subtitles.ar: هربت الحيوانات عندما رأت الغريب،|فحزن وقال: لقد منعتها من ماء تحتاج إليه.|نهض وترك لها المكان، ثم تابع طريقه حتى وصل إلى الكهف،|حيث استقبله الراعي بدهشة وفرح.
subtitles.en: The animals fled at his presence.|Regretting that he had kept them from water,|he moved on and reached the shepherd’s cave,|where he was warmly welcomed.

subtitles.ar: قال الزائر: جئت لأن حلمًا دلني عليك.|عاش الرجلان بعد ذلك معًا، يصلّيان|ويرعيان الغنم ويأكلان من لبنها ولحمها.|وظلا في الجبل حتى ماتا، وانتهت حكاية الزهاد.
subtitles.en: The visitor explained his dream.|The two men lived together in worship,|caring for the flock and eating its milk and meat,|until both eventually died.

new_assets.name: sheep
new_assets.description: The planned sheep (AN-040, AN-042), here with three extra opt-in fields: lie 0..1 (legs folded, body on the ground), shorn 0..1 (a neat bare square on the flank), eyes wide. Lamb = s 0.55 with a 1.2x head.
new_assets.implementation: Wool body = 7 overlapping circles (K blob) 190 x 110 with blue Ben-Day dots and a black brush outline; black rounded head with eye2() eyes and two ear ellipses; four black legs driven by walk() ph/amp like the deer; headDown rotates the neck pivot; chew offsets the jaw 2 px side to side; wrap in acting().

new_assets.name: dove (bird kind)
new_assets.description: The planned dove kind on the Library bird (blue-grey, white neck patch, pink chest; pal 1 male, pal 2 female, pal 3 pale).
new_assets.implementation: Add a BIRD.dove palette entry and a rounder body option; no change to the default kinds.

new_assets.name: rockyHill (terrace view: hermitLedge)
new_assets.description: The top terrace of the planned rockyHill with a sitting rock, crumb slab and dead snag; dimensions in sets.hermitLedge.
new_assets.implementation: Bake once: sky, far mountain polygons at 40 %, terrace polygon with grass tufts, cliff shelves as stepped grey polygons with dot shading and brush outline, snag as three tapered strokes. The village is six rectangles with triangle roofs.

new_assets.name: burrowChamber (rock palette: caveInterior)
new_assets.description: The planned cutaway chamber as a rock cave with a side mouth, mat, lamp niche and a bare back wall; dimensions in sets.caveInterior.
new_assets.implementation: Fill the frame with rock colour and dots, cut the cavity with an evenodd path filled navy with blue dots, cut the mouth and draw skyCycle behind it; floor line with pebbles. Palette and mouth side as options.

new_assets.name: hunterShadow (true-nature wall shadow)
new_assets.description: The planned effect, used for the angel: the woman casts a flat dark shadow on the back wall, 1.6x her size, 2 frames late, which grows folded then spread wings and a ring above the head.
new_assets.implementation: Draw the person silhouette (same pose, fill only, alpha 0.55 navy) scaled about her feet and offset to the wall, clipped to the wall rect; add two wing polygons (5 feather lobes each, span 0..300 keyed) and an ellipse ring stroke.

new_assets.name: angelLight
new_assets.description: A figure turns into a tall faceless shape of light and rises: p 0..0.4 bleaches the person from the feet up to white and yellow; p 0.4..1 replaces it with a tapering light column 90 wide x 300 tall with a round glow at head height, two wings (span 320, 6 lobes) that beat once, yellow halftone rays and star glints; then it shrinks to a star.
new_assets.implementation: Clip a white/yellow flat fill over the person by a rising horizontal line; cross-fade to the column (rounded polygon, yellow halftone disc r 150 behind, K star glints on seeded positions); wings as mirrored lobe polygons rotated about the shoulders with settleTo; y from kfn with ease-in.

new_assets.name: skyLight
new_assets.description: The planned soft cone of yellow halftone light from the top of the frame (or through the cave mouth), strength 0..1, used for the prayers.
new_assets.implementation: A trapezoid clip filled with yellow dots at alpha = strength x 0.5, soft edge by two wider passes at lower alpha.

new_assets.name: featherFall
new_assets.description: The planned feather effect; here mostly the single white feather that rocks down and comes to rest (five uses).
new_assets.implementation: Feather = a 34 x 9 leaf with a centre line; x sways on a seeded sine while y falls at constant speed; rotation follows the sway; rests flat on reaching the ground.

new_assets.name: person faceCover
new_assets.description: Opt-in field faceCover 0..1: a flap of the head cloth or robe (costume colour and dots) is drawn across the face from the far side, hiding eyes and mouth at 1; a puff value makes it bulge 3 px with the breath.
new_assets.implementation: After the head is drawn, clip to the head circle grown by 6 px and draw a rounded quad sliding in by faceCover, with two fold lines and a brush outline; hands come from PERSON_HANDS.cheeks. Default 0 draws nothing (regression safe).

new_assets.name: bread, prayerBeads, cookPot, smallBowl
new_assets.description: Small props, dimensions in props. smallBowl and beads reuse planned names.
new_assets.implementation: Each a short function of circles, ellipses and brush strokes; beads hang with swing().

new_assets.name: hutRoom, pond (small spring)
new_assets.description: Planned assets reused: the hut cutaway at night (S11) and the pond drawing at 260 x 46 as the spring (S12-S13).
new_assets.implementation: As planned by the other stories; only the dressing differs (mattress, moon window; stone rim and reeds).

new_assets.name: sneak
new_assets.description: The planned tiptoe option for walk(), used 141.4-142.2 as the visitor leaves the spring.
new_assets.implementation: walk() option: higher knee lift, a 0.12 s hold at each toe contact, half stride.

owner_questions: The angel is never drawn with a face in its true form: only a winged shadow on the wall (S8) and a rising shape of light with wings (S10); default used: this faceless treatment, please confirm it is acceptable to show an angel this way.

The two death moments (the hermit at 29.26, the two friends at 170.92) are shown as eyes closing peacefully and all motion stopping, with no fall, grave or body lying down; default used: this soft treatment.
'Eating its meat' (166.86) is shown only as a covered pot steaming on a fire, with no slaughter and no sheep in that shot; default used: pot only.
A wolf that creeps up and then lies down beside the lamb is added to picture "wild beasts did not attack his flock", and it returns once as a running gag at 164.12; default used: keep the wolf.
The pair of doves from the first tale and a white feather are used as a visual link between the two tales and in the final shot (not in the script); default used: keep the link.

Invented English lettering: PECK!, COO! COO!, BAA?, NO, THANK YOU!, PHEW!, ZIP!, WELCOME!, ME?, GO TO HIM! and the labels (THE HERMIT, HALF FOR HIM, HALF FOR THEM, SO THE TALE SAYS, THE SHEPHERD, MILK, WOOL, NO ATTACK!, ON THEIR OWN, AN ANGEL!, IN DISGUISE, THE TEST, TRY 1-3, TEST PASSED!, MY PATH, A NEARBY VILLAGE, SPRING, THE STRANGER, TOGETHER); default used: all kept, about 12 sound or speech words plus labels.
The woman's three extra attempts are staged as a blanket, a tray of food and a hand toward his shoulder that never touches him; default used: these three modest offers.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. Word cues come from timing.json; every cue in this plan lists the Arabic word and its start time on the final MP3.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so every character blinks; set noBlink on the hermit from 29.26 and on both men from 170.92 (their stillness must be absolute).
Groups never move in unison: give each dove and each sheep its own seed, delay (stagger(i)) and gaze. Only 12 doves act; the far ones are baked silhouettes that appear on their landing times.
The person figure is front-facing. Stage the two-shots with facing by dir, gaze (lookAt) and tip; the shepherd on the mat uses lie (head toward -x), so the woman always stands or kneels to his right.
S8: the woman herself must not change during the shadow reveal; only the shadow differs. The shepherd looks away from the wall throughout, so the audience knows more than he does.
S10: draw angelLight in place of the woman from p 0.4; never draw a face or a body inside the light. The cave walls take a yellow tint (alpha 0.25 overlay) while it is in frame.
S6 and S16 time lapses: animate skyCycle u with kfn; in S16 let u run past 1 (use u mod 1). Age blends through the person age field on both men; tint the tree crowns with mixHex.
S11 and S15 use one inside() function for the thought cloud so the callback is pixel-identical; keep the cloud shepherd at least 110 px tall on screen.

Sound: only the effects listed (times in sfx), master 0.6. Two sit in real pauses (3.3, 19.9) and one after the last word (174.9); the rest sit exactly on word boundaries because the narration has no other gaps, so keep them under 0.2 s and drop any that masks a word. No effect under the death beats.
Shake only inside the picture panel (template). Lettering and labels never cover a face; counters sit top-left or top-right of the panel.
After adding the opt-in fields (faceCover, sheep, dove kind, optional den bones switch) run node Library/tests/regression.mjs: it must report all identical.
warnings: The film is dense (eight paragraphs, two tales, five sets in 175 s). If a vignette in S15 (159.5-167.8) feels rushed, drop the wolf gag at 164.12 first.

The front-facing person cannot show a true profile; the cover-the-face beat (99.24) and the embrace (150.78) depend on the new faceCover field and world hand targets reading clearly at phone size. Check both with stills before the full render.
The Library den() may include the bones of the lion story; they must not appear on the shepherd's mountain.

The narration is almost continuous: the only real pauses are 2.92-3.74 and 19.56-20.64. Every other effect is placed exactly on a word boundary and must be very short (under 0.2 s) and quiet, or be dropped if it touches a word when heard.
The word at 169.66 (في) has an interpolated time; no action is cued to it.
